content: Israel-sordamar Madián-sordamargi-nakwisad
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga sunmakded, ega sogded:
“We-napneggi be naed-iduale, be-sergan-abargi be megnaed-iduale, be-dulemar-nuggine be Madián-dulemargi buged-mai be imakergebed. Geb a-sorbali, be burgoed.”
Geb degine, Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogded: “Bemar Madián-dulemargi bila-ononamalaga be-sordamar be guakwa urbemalo. Anmar Bab-Jehová-nuggine, egi buged-mai imakmaloed.
Bela Israel-dulemala, na dadgan-ambe-gakabogwad-iliba (12), miligwen-miligwen (1,000-1,000) bila-ononaega sordamar-barmidoed.”
Weyobi, Israel-dulemar, na dadgan-ambe-gakabogwad-iliba (12), miligwen-miligwen welesad. Degisoggu, bela miliambe-gakabo-mergu (12,000) bila-ononaega sordamar-amilesad.

Moisés, we-sordamarbali dule-irwa-Babse-goled-Eleazar-machi-Finees barmisad. A-Fineesʼde Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi nog-ebulemalad-semai gusad, degi, gar-trompeta semai gusbalid, adi, bila-onolealir ogolegar.
Bab-Jehová-Moisésʼga-sogsadba Israel-sordamar Madián-sordamargi bila-onodmargu, egi nakwismalad, bela ogilosmalad.
Israel-sordamar wemar-ogilosad-ukine, es-suidgi Madián-e-reymar-walataled oburgwismarbalid.
Deginbali, Israel-sordamar Madián-omegan, degi, Madián-mimmigan gasmalad. De-ukinbali, bela e-moli-bebe-nikamalad, e-sibad-wawaadmar, e-sibadmar, e-ibmar-nuegan e-ibe susmarbalid, bela ei searmalad.
Degi, Israel-sordamar bela Madián-dulemar-neggweburmar, e-neggwebur-burwiganse-bakar, ogumaksamalad.
Bela Madián-dulemar-galesadi, degi, e-ibmar-durgan-e-ibe-sulesadi,

bela Moisésʼse, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Eleazarʼse, degine, bela Israel-dulemarse searmalad. Deunni, Israel-dulemar Jordán-diwar-naba Moab-nebagan-naidgi Jericó-neggwebur-asabin danar-danar bukwamalad.
Moisés, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Eleazar, degi, Israel-dulemar-sapin-dummagan, danar-danar-bukwadgi ainiar gusmalad. Adi, danar-danar-bukwad-magaba sordamar-abindakegar.
Moisés, omegan-seledani dakargu, sordamar-idumaladse uluded, sordamar-miligwenad-e-dummaganse (1,000), sordamar-dulataled-e-dummaganse (100) uluded.
Ega sogded: “¿Ar ibiga bemar omegan-oburgwissuli?
We-omegan, Baal-Peorʼgi Balaam-ega-binsaed-uksadba, Israel-machergan-Bab-Jehováʼgi-isguega imaksamalad. A-ulale, Israel-machergan bukidar burgwisad.”
Moisés sogdebalid: “Degisoggu, bela masmala-oburgwemalo, degine, bela omegan-machergan-nikusmalad be oburgwemarbalo.
Unnila, omegan-yoo-macherganbo-gabmaladbi be odulomalo, adi, melle oburgwemalo.”
Sorda-bila-onodimalad, degi, dule-galesmalad-san-uruked-igar

Moisés, Israel-sordamarga sogded: “Bemardina, be dule-wargwen-oburgwisale, igi, mui-ebusale, ibagugle (7) dulemar-danar-danar-bukwad-magaba gudii guoed. Ibapaagwadgi, degi, ibagugledgi (7) bemar san-urukmaloed, degi, dulemar-galesmalad san-urukmarmogoed.
Deginbali, bela be-mormala, be-ibmar-ukamar, be-sibad-e-absarmar, degi, be-ibmarmar-urgogi-sobarmalad be enukbaloed.”
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Eleazar, sordamar-bila-onodidanimaladga sogded: “Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga weyob igar-uksad:
‘Olo, mani, esgoro-gordikid, esgoro, esgoro-estañoʼye-nugad, gingwa,

degine, bela ibmarmar soo-abin geg-akargumalad, soogi be ogoed. Adi, a-ibmarmar swilidik guoed. Geb degi, ibmar-uruked-diigi be urukbaloed. Ibmarmar soo-abin-gummakdedamaladdi unnila ibmar-uruked-diigi be urukoed.
Ibagugledgine (7), bemar, be-mormar enukoed. Geb agi, be swilidik gumaloed. Geb dulemar-danar-danar-bukwadse gannar be dogmaloed.’ ”
Ibmar-mimilemaloed-igar
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga sogdebalid:

“Dule-irwa-anse-goled-Eleazarʼga, degi, Israel-dule-danar-danar-bukmalad-e-dummaganga ibmar-ebisega be-bendakmarye be sogo. Dulemar-gales-selenonimalad be ebismalo, degi, bela ibdurganmar-gales-selenonimalad ebismarbalo.
Geb degine, sordamar-bila-onoapmaladga negabar ibmar be ukoed, Israel-dulemar-baiganga negabar be ukmogoed.
Sorda-bila-onoapmaladga-ibmar-uklegoedi, anga be sumogoed.

content.text: We-ibmarmala dule-irwa-anse-goled-Eleazarʼga be ukoed, adi, anga ukegar.

content: ”Baid-negabalad Israel-dulemarga-uklegoedi, anga be subaloed.
Moisés, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Eleazarʼbo Bab-Jehová-ega-igar-uksadba imaksamalad.

content.text: Sibad-wawaad, mili-dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulagwen-gakambe gakagugle gaka dulataled-ilatar (337,500).

content: Moisés, Bab-Jehová-ega-igar-uksadba dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Eleazarʼga ibmarmar-Bab-Jehováʼga-uklegoed uksad.
Degi, sordamar-bila-onoapmalad-ibmar-senonimaladi, Moisés negabala Israel-dulemarga uksamogad.

content.text: Sibad-wawaad, mili-dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulagwen-gakambe gakagugle gaka dulataled-ilatar (337,500).

content: We-ibmar-Israel-dulemarga-uklesadi, Moisés dulemar-dulabo-gakambegwad-iliba (50) war-wargwen susad. Degi, ibdurgan-dulabo-gakambegwad-iliba (50) war-wargwen susbalid. Bab-Jehová-ega-igar-uksadba imaksad. Geb bela Moisés we-ibmarmala Leví-wagan-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbamaladga uksad.
Sordamar-idumalad Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uksad
Degidgine, sordamar-idumaladi, sordamar-miligwenad-e-dummagana (1,000), sordamar-dulataled-e-dummagana (100), Moisésʼse nonimalad.
Ega weyob sognonimalad: “Anmala bega-arbamaladi, anmar na egad-egad sordamar-sediid ebichismalad. Dakleargu, wargwensaale anmar-sordamar bilagi burgwissulid.
A-ulale, anmar na ibmar-orbiid-amismaladi Bab-Jehováʼga sedanimalad, adi, anmar-isgued-ular ukegar.
Degine, Moisés, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Eleazarʼbo sorda-bila-onomalad-e-dummagan ega-ibmar-orgi-sobarmalad-senonimalad abin susmalad.
Sordamar-idumaladi, sordamar-miligwenad-e-dummagana (1,000), sordamar-dulataled-e-dummagana (100) belagwapa Bab-Jehováʼga or-uksamaladi, nibir-dulataled-ilabake gaka dulagwen-aidiku (420) uksamalad.
Sorda-bila-onomaladi, na egad-egad wala-walagwen ibmarmar susgusmalad.
Moisés, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Eleazarʼbo sorda-bila-onomalad-e-dummagan ega-or-uksamaladi, Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-negse sesad, adi, Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-ibmar-imaksad ebinsaegar.
